name: More than Forever: A Tragic Love Story
source:
"Will you love me forever?"

William and Shirley love each other with all their heart and have been going strong for quite some time, but one misunderstanding later and an irreversible tragedy occurs. Even after this, will their love stand the test of time?

It's more than a simple romance. This is a tale that will bring tears to your eyes.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=19066]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
「你會永遠愛我嗎？」

威廉與雪莉全心全意地相愛，感情也已經穩定地維繫了相當長的時間。然而，一場誤會引發了無法挽回的悲劇。即使如此，他們的愛情還能經得起時間的考驗嗎？

這不只是一段普通的戀情，而是一個會讓你潸然淚下的故事。

（摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=19066]Lemma Soft論壇[/url]）
